public_rationale: Court records document January proceedings, a May preservation order, December rulings, and a December 29 filing in ongoing generative-AI copyright litigation. Together they support continued litigation throughout 2025. Some claims were dismissed or stayed, but Marcus did not predict that every claim would survive or that plaintiffs would win.
limitations: The records establish continuing litigation, not the merits of infringement allegations.
The assessment uses continuing cases rather than requiring a separate filing in every month.
